Curriculum & Playbooks

Architecture Playbooks & Learning Paths

Practical guides based on real enterprise projects. No toy examples: each track covers what tends to go wrong, where the boundaries should sit, and the patterns that hold up in production.

Learning path tracks

Track 01 / Production Playbook

Terraform for Enterprise Production

A practical guide to building and running Terraform in enterprise AWS: module structure, keeping state safe, refactoring without downtime, handling secrets, and automated checks in CI/CD.

Terraform 1.5+ · AWS · HCL · Checkov · TFLint · S3 & DynamoDB

6 Production modules
45 min total read
Intermediate to Advanced Explore curriculum →
Track 02 / Migration Playbook

Enterprise Cloud Migration: Assess, Mobilize & Modernize

An architecture and cost guide for enterprise cloud migrations: rapid (4–6 week) versus deep (3–4 month) assessments, 3-year cost modelling including Savings Plans and Microsoft licensing, landing zone design, wave planning, and modernizing along the way.

AWS MAP · AWS Transform · RVTools · TCO Modeling · Landing Zone · Amazon EKS

6 Delivery modules
50 min total read
Intermediate to Executive Explore curriculum →
Track 03 / Foundations to Production

Kubernetes on Amazon EKS: Foundations to Production

A structured path from how Kubernetes works to running Amazon EKS in production: the fundamentals first (control plane, pods, Services, access), then building the platform, then shipping and running it. Traffic-flow diagrams throughout. Assumes you know containers; no Kubernetes experience needed.

Kubernetes · Amazon EKS · kubectl · AWS Load Balancer Controller · Argo CD · Karpenter

14 Modules in three parts
120 min total read
